title: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players
abstract: arXiv:2610.33845v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can LLM agents carry a hard real-world problem from raw data to a system that holds its own against people? We study this in Hearthstone Battlegrounds, an eight-player auto-battler with stochastic shops and battles, hidden information and nearly a thousand interacting cards. We present AutoTavern, a self-improving research system: specialised LLM research agents share a typed research memory, every claim passes verification gates, and live games close the loop, so the agents improve the simulator, opponents and policy and, from the same feedback, their own research process; a human sets goals and rules on ambiguous mechanics. In 20 days AutoTavern built TavernGym, the first faithful, full-content reproduction of the live game, and delivered 23 versions of TavernAgent, trained with PPO against opponents calibrated to real games. translated_title: 构建而非游玩：自我改进的LLM研究智能体开发出媲美顶尖玩家的炉石传说酒馆战棋AI
translated_abstract: LLM智能体能否将一个困难的现实世界问题从原始数据一步步推进到足以与人类抗衡的系统？我们在炉石传说酒馆战棋中研究这一问题——这是一款八人自走棋游戏，具有随机的商店与战斗、隐藏信息以及近千张相互作用的卡牌。我们提出了AutoTavern，一个自我改进的研究系统：专门的LLM研究智能体共享一个类型化的研究记忆，每条论断都必须通过验证关卡，而实时游戏则形成闭环反馈，使智能体能够改进模拟器、对手和策略，并基于同样的反馈改进它们自身的研究过程；人类仅在机制模糊之处设定目标和规则。在20天内，AutoTavern构建了TavernGym——首个忠实且包含全部内容的正式游戏复现，并交付了23个版本的TavernAgent，该智能体使用PPO在与真实游戏校准的对手上训练。TavernAgent能够在正式天梯上独立完成完整对局：其评分从6,000攀升至约15,000……
tldr: AutoTavern通过自我改进的LLM研究智能体系统，在20天内从零构建了炉石酒馆战棋的完整忠实模拟器，并训练出在天梯上从6,000分攀升至约15,000分、足以媲美顶尖人类玩家的AI智能体。
en_tdlr: AutoTavern, a self-improving system of specialized LLM research agents, built a faithful full-content Hearthstone Battlegrounds simulator and a PPO-trained AI agent in 20 days, whose live-ladder rating climbed from 6,000 to ~15,000, rivaling top human players.
